subject: Supplier onboarding: PO token issuance and line-code mismatch resolution
messages:
From: Amelia Jones <amelia.jones@starlane.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@starlane.io>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New supplier: onboarding form + initial PO request

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the quick intro. Attached is Starlane's completed onboarding form and our standard vendor W-9. We need a provisional PO number to kick off the first month of usage while procurement processes the full contract.

Details:
- Company: Starlane Analytics
- Proposed billing entity: Starlane US LLC
- Initial requested spend cap: $50,000 (monthly)
- Line items (from our catalogue):
  * SL-CORE-1: LLM inference (flat monthly pool)
  * SL-OBS-10: Observability addon (per-host)
  * SL-ONB-ADV: Onboarding services (one-time)

We also noticed an earlier purchase-code in your onboarding matrix (ledger tag 12-34-567) — our finance team maps that to a SKU set on our side, and sometimes the line-code in your PO generator drops the trailing digit. That mismatch causes downstream ledger reconciliation errors. Can you issue a provisional PO with a line-code that preserves the full SKU (e.g., include the -L suffix)?

Attachments: [Attachment: starlane_vendor_form.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: starlane_w9.pdf (PDF)]

Appreciate it — Amelia
Amelia Jones
Head of Procurement, Starlane Analytics
amelia.jones@starlane.io
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Jones <amelia.jones@starlane.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier: onboarding form + initial PO request

Thanks, Amelia — got the form and W-9. Marking ProcureOps ticket (PROC-4821) as the intake record.

Quick notes / next steps:
- I'll request a provisional PO number from procurement today and include a line-item that preserves your SKU suffix (we can use the -L1 convention you suggested).
- Marcus, can you confirm whether the $50k monthly spend cap can be provisionally encoded or whether we should set a hard token-based cap in our billing system?
- Amelia, we'll also need your billing contact and the person who signs PO-level invoices (for our AP flow).

I'll loop back with the PO once procurement issues it.

Best,
Mina
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: po_terms_draft.docx (DOCX)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier: onboarding form + initial PO request

On Mon, Nov 1, 2026 at 11:05 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Amelia — got the form and W-9. Marking ProcureOps ticket (PROC-4821) as the intake record.

Mina — noted. Two operational points from finance that will affect the PO payload:
1) Our PO generator enforces a spend-band field which in our billing tiering maps to a numeric cap. We can set that to $50,000 provisional but legal prefers a note that the cap is provisional until SOW is signed.
2) Line-code preservation: our ledger pipes truncate tokens longer than 12 chars unless flagged as LINESUFF. For Starlane SKUs we need to set the line meta flag so your SKUs keep the -L suffix.

I'll open a quick procurement sub-ticket to request the PO. Temporary PO we can provide: RN-2026-6221 (provisional). It includes:
- PO: PO-RW-2026-5587 (primary)
- Line: PO-RW-2026-5587-L1 mapped to SL-CORE-1

Marissa — can you attach the reconciliation checklist and confirm we have the right billing contact before we issue?

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Finance Ops
From: Amelia Jones <amelia.jones@starlane.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@starlane.io>
Date: 2026-11-02T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier: onboarding form + initial PO request

Thanks Marcus — that provisional PO looks fine.

Billing contact:
- Name: Robert Hale
- Email: robert.hale@starlane.io
- Phone: +1-415-555-0192

We have attached the signed onboarding PDF and the signature page for the W-9. One more ask: given anticipated throughput in month 1, can procurement temporarily lift the spend cap to $75,000 (provisional) while we validate usage over the first two billing cycles? If not, we'll start at $50k and request a mid-cycle increase.

Attachments: [Attachment: signed_onboarding.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: signed_w9_page.pdf (PDF)]

—Amelia
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Jones <amelia.jones@starlane.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: PO issued: PO-RW-2026-5587 (+line correction) — next steps

Amelia / Starlane team —

Thanks for the signed forms. Procurement has issued the provisional PO and preserved the line suffix as requested. Final details below:

Issued PO payload:
- PO number: PO-RW-2026-5587
- Line item token: PO-RW-2026-5587-L1 — maps to SL-CORE-1 (preserves -L suffix for your ledger)
- Observability addon: PO-RW-2026-5587-L2 -> SL-OBS-10
- Onboarding services (one-time): PO-RW-2026-5587-L3 -> SL-ONB-ADV
- Provisional spend cap: $50,000 (set in accounting system as provisional cap; finance can approve temporary increases via PROC-4821 sub-ticket)

Notes and actions:
- Marcus: please leave the RN-2026-6221 internal reference in the ticket until the SOW is signed.
- Amelia: to request the $75k provisional increase, please file a request in PROC-4821 with any updated forecast (we'll fast-track review).
- Marissa / Jonas: please confirm the PO files are in shared drive and that billing contact Robert Hale is added to the AP whitelist.

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4821 (procurement ticket)

If everything looks good I'll move this PO to Active and notify AP.

Best,
Mina
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_po_record_PO-RW-2026-5587.pdf (PDF stub)]
